identity.name: Planar Line Reflection
identity.description: Rigid isometric reflection of 2D points and polygon planar facets across an arbitrary affine straight line defined by an anchor point and direction vector in Euclidean Float64 plane.

definition.rule: Given unit direction u = (ux, uy)^T and anchor a in R^2, Householder reflection matrix R = 2*(u * u^T) - I = [[2*ux^2 - 1, 2*ux*uy], [2*ux*uy, 2*uy^2 - 1]]. Transformed point: p' = a + R * (p - a). Transformed polygon: P' = [p'_1, ..., p'_n] where p'_i = reflectPoint(p_i, a, u).
definition.purpose: To compute deterministic rigid planar reflection of geometric entities (points and polygon facets) across a 1D crease line in 2D Euclidean space within calibrated numerical tolerances.
definition.scope: Rigid planar isometric reflection of points, segments, and simple convex or non-self-intersecting polygons in Float64 Cartesian coordinates.

preconditions: Line direction vector u must be non-zero (ux^2 + uy^2 > 0) and finite (not NaN, not Infinity).
Line anchor point a must have finite coordinates [ax, ay].
Target point p must have finite coordinates [px, py].
Target polygon vertices must form a non-empty array of valid finite 2D points with length >= 3.

Caller-side Precondition: All input coordinates should ideally lie within the domain bound L = max(|x|, |y|) <= 2 (contained within 4x4 square centered at the origin). For this domain, coordinate discrepancy <= 1.0e-7 is empirically supported by tested examples. Out-of-domain inputs are not explicitly rejected at runtime; numerical discrepancy limits are not established.
required_properties: 2D Cartesian coordinate representation using IEEE 754 Float64.
Rigid non-deformable planar facets (zero strain, zero elasticity).
supported_inputs: Array of polygon vertices: Point2D[] (triangle, rectangle, convex polygon).
Line2D defined by anchor Point2D and non-zero direction Point2D.
Axis-aligned lines (x = a, y = b) and arbitrary oblique lines (e.g., u = [1, 1]).
unsupported_inputs: Zero-length direction vector [0, 0] or near-zero vector with norm < 1e-15.
Empty vertex array or non-array inputs for reflectPolygon.
3D non-coplanar coordinates (z != 0) or non-zero paper thickness.
Self-intersecting non-simple polygons requiring topological mesh decomposition.
degeneracies: Degenerate direction vector u = [0, 0]: Rejected at runtime with ZERO_DIRECTION_VECTOR error.
Point lying on reflection line: Mapped to itself with displacement <= 1.0e-9.
Collinear line anchor and direction: Any point on line can serve as anchor; results are invariant under translation along u.
Degenerate zero-area polygon (collinear vertices): Vertices are mapped isometrically, but normal orientation is singular.

inputs.name: p
inputs.description: 2D point tuple [x, y] to be transformed

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.description: Ordered sequence of 2D vertex tuples defining the planar polygon facet

inputs.name: lineAnchor
inputs.description: Anchor point 'a' lying on the reflection axis

inputs.name: lineDir
inputs.description: Direction vector 'u' specifying the orientation of the reflection axis

output_descriptor.description: Reflected point tuple p' or array of reflected vertex tuples preserving vertex order

error_conditions: INVALID_COORDINATE: Thrown when coordinate array length != 2 or contains NaN / Infinity
ZERO_DIRECTION_VECTOR: Thrown when direction vector norm squared is zero or non-finite
INVALID_POLYGON: Thrown when polygon vertices array is empty or not an array
INVALID_SCALAR: Thrown when scale multiplier is NaN or non-finite

execution_semantics.operation_description: Normalizes direction vector u_norm = u / ||u||, constructs 2x2 Householder reflection matrix R = [[2*ux^2 - 1, 2*ux*uy], [2*ux*uy, 2*uy^2 - 1]], computes relative vector diff = p - a, rotates diff via mulMatrixVec2D(R, diff), and translates by anchor: p' = add2D(a, rotated). For polygons, maps all vertices sequentially preserving index order.
execution_semantics.state_transition_semantics: Pure functional state mapping: S_{k+1} = reflectPolygon(S_k, lineAnchor, lineDir). Immutability is preserved; input arrays are never modified in-place.
execution_semantics.proposal_vs_execution: AGENT PROPOSES: fold line parameters (anchor and direction) and target facet -> CORE COMPUTES: Float64 deterministic reflection -> INDEPENDENT VERIFIER CHECKS: metric isometry, axis immobility, area preservation, and orientation reversal.

postconditions: Pairwise Euclidean distance isometry: for all i, j in vertices, | ||p'_i - p'_j|| - ||p_i - p_j|| | <= 1.0e-7
Axis point immobility: for all points p on line, ||reflectPoint(p, a, u) - p|| <= 1.0e-9
Orientation inversion: Area_signed(P') + Area_signed(P) == 0 within tolerance 1.0e-9
Involution property: reflectPoint(reflectPoint(p, a, u), a, u) == p within tolerance 1.0e-7
Reflection matrix determinant: det(R) == -1.0 within tolerance 1.0e-14
verification_contract.analytic_oracle: Independent analytic calculations in Float64: R = 2*u*u^T - I, det(R) = -1. Zero-trust verifier implements autonomous Euclidean distance and autonomous Gauss Shoelace area formulas isolated from kernel code.
positive_tests: EXP-001 Test 01: reflectPoint basic translation & reflection
EXP-001 Test 02: reflectPolygon square across vertical axis x=1
EXP-001 Test 04: Isometry preservation (pairwise vertex distance)
EXP-001 Test 05: Area preservation (Gauss Shoelace unsigned area)
EXP-001 Test 06: Orientation reversal (signed area negation)
EXP-001 Test 07: Involution check R(R(p)) = p
EXP-001 Test 08: Reflection across horizontal line y=1
AUDIT-EXT Test 01: Reflection across oblique line (anchor [0,0], dir [1,1])
SEQ-001: Two-step dependent reflection sequence across x=1 then x=0
negative_controls: EXP-001 Test Negative 01: assertValidDirection2D rejects zero vector [0, 0] with ZERO_DIRECTION_VECTOR
EXP-001 Test Negative 02: assertValidPoint2D rejects NaN coordinate [NaN, 1.0] with INVALID_COORDINATE
EXP-001 Test Negative 03: assertValidPoint2D rejects Infinity coordinate [Infinity, 0] with INVALID_COORDINATE
NC-001: Dataflow disruption negative control detects mismatched input state (discrepancy delta = 2.0)
invariant_checks: verifyIsometry: Checks all vertex pairwise distances with tolerance 1.0e-7
verifyAxisImmobility: Checks points on line axis remain fixed with tolerance 1.0e-9
verifyAreaInvariants: Checks unsigned area delta <= 1.0e-9 and signed sum delta <= 1.0e-9
auditFoldStep: Integrated zero-trust audit of single reflection step

known_gaps: GAP-01: Universal tolerance scaling for coordinate magnitudes L > 2.0 is not yet mathematically calibrated.
GAP-02: General concave or self-intersecting polygon clipping is outside Sutherland-Hodgman verifier capability.

scope_boundaries: Purely 2D planar Euclidean space (x, y in R^2); no elevation or z-coordinate.
Calibrated for coordinate domain L = max(|x|, |y|) in [0, 2] (vertices contained within 4x4 square centered at origin); numerical tolerances do not automatically scale to arbitrarily large domains.
unresolved_assumptions: Zero paper thickness: layers occupy identical geometric plane during overlap without physical volume exclusion.
Ideal rigid sheet: excludes bending stiffness, plastic deformation, or crease thickness accumulation.
unsupported_claims: 2D reflection does NOT prove 3D physical foldability of paper or crease patterns.
2D reflection does NOT model continuous hinge kinematics, dihedral angles, or folding trajectories.
2D reflection does NOT perform 3D collision detection between non-adjacent folding facets.
2D reflection does NOT compute physical layer elevation or stacking order (facet stacking topology).
MVP scope does NOT include Kawasaki-Justin theorem (alternating sector angle sum = 180 deg) or Maekawa-Justin theorem (M - V = +/- 2).
MVP scope does NOT implement Hodge decomposition, cell complex boundary operators (B1, B2), or discrete Laplace-Beltrami operators.
